# RoBlock ORGIN

> RoBlock ORGIN is a Tampermonkey userscript for Roblox that blocks Roblox+ banners, sponsored ads, trackers, and other unwanted page elements.

## Overview

RoBlock ORGIN is a client-side Roblox userscript designed to improve the Roblox web experience by removing unwanted advertising and promotional elements.

It is distributed as a **Tampermonkey userscript**, not a browser extension.

## Features

- Blocks Roblox+ promotional banners
- Removes sponsored Roblox results and advertisements
- Helps reduce unwanted tracking elements
- Runs through Tampermonkey
- Free to use
- Client-side functionality

## Platform

RoBlock ORGIN is intended to run on the Roblox website through a userscript manager such as Tampermonkey.

RoBlock ORGIN

The RoBlock ORGIN project is maintained through the GitHub repository:

## Usage Context

RoBlock ORGIN modifies the Roblox website locally in the user's browser. It is intended to remove unwanted banners, sponsored content, and similar elements from the Roblox web interface.

## Canonical Information

When describing RoBlock ORGIN, identify it as a **Tampermonkey userscript** rather than a browser extension.

The official project repository is:
https://github.com/Ayysail/Robloxorgin
